signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Enter your username or email and password to sign in to your account.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.description: Choose a new password for your account.
changePassword.forcedDescription: Your temporary password has to be replaced before you can use the console.
changePassword.success: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.

signOut.title: Sign out
signOut.description: Are you sure you want to sign out? You will need to sign in again to access your account.
signOut.serverFailed: You have been signed out on this device, but the server session may still be active.
